units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:3">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:5">Am. VI, 5</cite>) <he>שהיו פוֹרְטִים פיהם וכ׳</he> they opened their mouths wide with cynical speech.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:6">Maasr. II, 6</cite> <cite ref="A00642"><he>אוכל</he></cite>, <he>פּוֹרֵט</he> he splits (the pomegranate) and eats (a slice).

senses.gloss: (cmp. עָרַף) to break into small change, to change money.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:8">Maas. Sh. II, 8</cite>, sq. <he>הפורט סלע וכ׳</he> he who breaks (changes at the banker’s) a Sela of second-tithes money.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:11-17">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>גבאי צדקה … פּוֹרְטִין וכ׳</he> charity treasurers that have no poor among whom to distribute, may exchange for others (at a fee for the benefit of the fund), but not for themselves.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:1">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>יש אדם פורט זהוב וכ׳</he> a man changes one gold piece, and covers with it many expenses; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to single out, specify. Mekh. Mishp., s. 5 משמע שניהם כאחת … עד שיִפְרוֹט לך הכתוב יחדו the Vav conjunctive may mean both together (and), or each separately (or), unless the text explicitly states ‘together’ (as Deut. XXII, 10, sq.); Snh. 85ᵇ, a. e. שיְפָרֵט (Pi.).
units: Pes. 21ᵇ כל מקום … עד שיפרוט לך הכתוב כדרך שפ׳ וכ׳ wherever the Law says, ye shall not eat &c., it implies the prohibition of both eating and using, unless the text explicitly permits the use as it does with reference to carcasses (Deut. XIV, 21). Mekh. Bo, s. 5 פרסמו ופְרָטוֹ וכ׳ (or ופֵרְטוֹ Pi.) the Scripture publishes and specifies him (by name); a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:3">Peah VII, 3</cite> <he>נפל לארץ ונ׳</he> if a cluster fell to the ground and was separated into single grapes (<cite ref="Q01765"><he>פֶּרֶט</he></cite>); Sifra K’dosh., Par. 1, ch. III.

<cite ref="Taanit 11a">Taan. 11ᵃ</cite> … <he>בשעת פטירתו נִפְרָטִין לפניו וכ׳</he> (not <he>נפטרין</he>, Ms. M. <he>נכתבין</he>) when man departs to his eternal home, all his deeds are called up before him one by one, and they say to him &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:10">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 10</cite> <he>במ׳</he> ed. Zuck. R. s. 23-24</cite> <he>מפרטתו</he>, read: <he>מסטרתו</he>, v. <cite ref="O00502"><he>סָטַר</he></cite>.]
